name: Mitake (Gifu, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mitake town emblem in green: an outlined stylised letter M with a drop at the centre.
history: Municipal flag of Mitake, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Mitake town emblem — an outlined stylised letter M with a drop at the centre
